findings.evidence: NEW_RUN7_P1_AUDIT_INTEGRITY — Wave C bailed at state 05 with `BLOCKED@payment-screen`. Root cause: spec line 222 comment claims `Item 361 has wizard_template=simple with 0 variations/extras, so click on kiosk-product-add-361 pops a 1-step recap OR jumps straight to cart-indicator update`. This assumption is FALSE in run-7: clicking `kiosk-product-add-361` opens a wizard at `data-testid="kiosk-step-frites-style"` with 3 fries-style options (Frites nature / Cheddar fondu +€1,00 / Cheddar+Oignons +€2,00). The wizard has visual steps `STYLE FRITES → RÉCAP` (slot 2 chips). 04-kiosk-cart-bottom-sheet.dom.html at line 7390+ confirms `class="kiosk-wizard-overlay slide-up-enter-active slide-up-enter-to"` and `data-testid="kiosk-step-frites-style"`. The spec waitForFunction polls for `kiosk-order-summary-root` OR `cart-indicator >= 1 article` — neither resolves because (a) no `kiosk-order-summary-root` is ever rendered (different testid), (b) cart stays at 0 because the wizard awaits SUIVANT click. Spec then blindly clicks `kiosk-categories-pay` (disabled, no-op), then waits for `kiosk-cart-root|kiosk-payment-root` (also never appears) → 10s timeout → catch block snaps `05-kiosk-blocked-at-payment`. EITHER (1) Frites Seules item 361 was promoted from simple → composite wizard in seed/CV1 (catalog regression, not necessarily a defect), OR (2) spec author never updated it after the wizard surface unification. Per protocol category 8 (aria/keyboard) and category 6 (silent_error: spec hits a disabled CTA without surfacing why), this is P1 — production-breaking for the audit pipeline.
findings.fix_hint: (1) Update spec line 222-289 to drive the kiosk-step-frites-style → click `kiosk-frites-style-nature` (the cheapest) → click `.kiosk-btn-next` (SUIVANT) → wait for RÉCAP → click `.kiosk-btn-next` again to commit-to-cart. (2) Add explicit polling assertion: `kiosk-categories-pay:not([disabled])` BEFORE clicking it. (3) Confirm with backend whether Frites Seules id 361 is now wizard_template=composite (and update the spec comment if so). (4) Failing fast and explicitly is preferable: if cart=0 after 5s of wizard interaction, throw with `[KIOSK-RT] wizard did not commit cart` rather than silently snapping a misleading `05-kiosk-blocked-at-payment`.
